title: On the Wiener and Harary Indices of Generalized Splitting and Shadow-Splitting Graphs
summary: In this paper, we determine the Wiener index and the Harary index for the $(p,q)$-generalized splitting graph $S_{p,q}(G)$ and the $(c,k)$-shadow-splitting graph $H_{c,k}(G)$ for a connected graph $G$.
